messages:
sophia: T-minus 45 for the hotfix window — PR 9241 still needs 2x LGTM or it misses the cutoff. Small fix to kv cache marshaling, low risk. https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/9241

mike: pinging @olivia and @lee for second eyes. I can give one LGTM if CI and a quick smoke pass are green.

olivia: quick q — any DB migration or schema touches in this PR?

sophia: no DB changes. I added a one-line changelog in the last commit per request. Smoke command below, takes ~2m:
```
./scripts/smoke.sh --pr 9241
```

lee: starting smoke now on a staging replica, will report back in ~3m.

deploy-bot: preflight checks queued for PR 9241 — CI: 12/12 jobs triggered.

lee: smoke passed on staging, no obvious memory regressions. left a tiny nits comment about logging but non-blocking. LGTM from me.

mike: LGTM — thanks @lee. @sophia if you squash/fix the nit I'll do the merge right after. @carla can you standby for monitoring?

emma: hold up — noticed this touches code that the feature-flag rollout next week will also touch. Recommend we do a small canary (5%) rather than full push so we don't overlap changes.

sophia: doing a 5% canary is fine, will we still make the hotfix window if we do that? ETA for canary ramp config is ~15m.

carla: ops prefers 5% canary for safety, I can watch dashboards and abort if anything weird.

mike: ok, merging with the plan: merge -> 5% canary -> monitor -> widen if stable. I'll squash the nit and merge in a minute.

deploy-bot: merge committed by mike at 1738912570, rollout started (targeting 5% of prod).

carla: monitoring dashboards look clean for the 5% shard, no error spikes in the first 10m.

sophia: excellent — thanks everyone for quick eyes. :heart:

mike: leaving post-merge note in the PR with rollback steps and the canary timeline.

carla: marking the release as "canary-in-progress" in the runbook.

sophia: closing the loop here — hotfix window met thanks to the rapid reviews.
